title: BlockHunt
description: Disguise yourself as blocks and hide around the world with decoys!
body:
# About
Inspired by youtube shorts of creators playing hide and seek by turning into blocks!!

# Features
- Selection Tool: Turns the player into selected block that you are looking at
- Lock Tool: Teleports the player to the center of the block (to be more convincing)
- Decoy Tool: Creates a killable decoy of yourself to put off hunters!

# Usage:
/blockhunt game start
/blockhunt game end


Project files are all open source, github linked [here](https://github.com/Daxz0/blockhunt)
